# http://docs.copilotkit.ai llms.txt

> CopilotKit is a set of tools for building AI copilots and agents in your applications. It provides React components, hooks, and a runtime for integrating LLMs directly into your app.

## Core Documentation

- [Introduction](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/llms-full.txt): Full documentation content in markdown format for LLM consumption.

## Key Topics

- [CopilotKit Documentation](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/): Build production-ready Copilots and Agents effortlessly.
- [Quickstart Guide](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/quickstart): Quickly integrate CopilotKit for chat functionality in apps.
- [Self-Hosting Copilot Runtime](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/self-hosting): Learn to self-host Copilot Runtime for seamless integration.
- [Integrate Your LLM](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/bring-your-own-llm): Learn to integrate any LLM with CopilotKit easily.

## React Hooks

- [useCopilotAction](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/hooks/useCopilotAction): React hook for custom actions in Copilot applications.
- [useCopilotReadable](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/hooks/useCopilotReadable): React hook for managing app state with Copilot.
- [useCopilotChat](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/hooks/useCopilotChat): React hook for interacting with Copilot chat instance.
- [useCopilotChatSuggestions](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/hooks/useCopilotChatSuggestions): Generate chat suggestions based on app state.

## UI Components

- [CopilotKit Provider](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/components/CopilotKit): The root provider component for CopilotKit.
- [CopilotPopup](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/components/chat/CopilotPopup): Interactive chatbot popup component.
- [CopilotSidebar](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/components/chat/CopilotSidebar): Customizable sidebar component.
- [CopilotChat](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/components/chat/CopilotChat): Chat component for custom layouts.
- [CopilotTextarea](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/v1/components/CopilotTextarea): AI-powered textarea with autocomplete.

## CoAgents (Agent Infrastructure)

- [LangGraph Integration](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/coagents): Build agent-native applications with LangGraph.
- [Shared State](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/coagents/shared-state): Synchronize agent and UI state.
- [Generative UI](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/coagents/generative-ui): Render agent state with custom UI components.
- [Human-in-the-Loop](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/coagents/human-in-the-loop): Set checkpoints for human guidance.
- [Frontend Actions](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/coagents/frontend-actions): Give agents the ability to act in the frontend.
- [Multi-Agent Flows](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/coagents/multi-agent-flows): Orchestrate complex flows with multiple agents.

## Guides

- [Connect Your Data](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/connect-your-data): Connect your data to CopilotKit.
- [Custom Look and Feel](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/custom-look-and-feel): Customize CopilotKit's UI.
- [Backend Actions](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/backend-actions): Implement backend actions and agents.
- [Copilot Suggestions](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/copilot-suggestions): Auto-generate chat suggestions.
- [Message History](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/messages-localstorage): Save and restore message history.
- [Guardrails](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/guardrails): Implement content moderation guardrails.

## Troubleshooting

- [Common Issues](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/troubleshooting/common-issues): Solutions to common CopilotKit issues.
- [Using the Dev Console](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/troubleshooting/dev-console): Debug your copilot using the built-in Dev Console.
